title: Portable VideoML integration and local-first paid rendering
description: Babulus becomes an optional paid rendering platform for portable VideoML projects, using a local-worker grace period and bounded AWS Batch fallback. Native coordination record for VideoML/toolchain initiative videoml-dbc2b1 (Hyperframes inspiration), which remains the canonical design and execution plan. Preserve existing behavior while adopting shared demos; implement portable bundles, fenced leases, customer credits and hard admission controls through linked P packets. A dedicated new AWS account is required; do not reuse the existing Babulus account automatically. No deployment or costs enabled by this planning issue. Follow Babulus commit-approval rule; local implementation can proceed.
